content_metadata.description: A beginner's guide on how to use a laser level for marking grade levels for concrete floors, including setup, usage, and troubleshooting.

qAndA.question: What color is the laser beam emitted by the laser level?
What does the receiver do when it finds the laser beam?
What measurement on the grade stick indicates the desired top level of the concrete floor?

youtube_description:
#Laserlevelbasics #HowToUseALaserLevel #MikeDayConcrete

In this video I'm showing you how to use a laser level to set a level grade for a concrete floor. I'll show you how to set up a self leveling laser, how to use a grade stick, how the receiver for the laser works, and how to determine your grades for your concrete floor.
A rotary laser level is a tool that shoots a laser beam of light 360 degrees around a room. I use the level laser beam to establish my grades when I prep for a concrete floor pour. 
The laser level is a fast and accurate way for one person to check, establish, and mark grades for all kinds of concrete work. If you've never used a laser level, this video will give you a good introduction as how to use one.
